skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit Angelina had tailored specially before setting out for Rim Billiton.
The fabric—breathable and sun-resistant at once—was settled in minutes; only the colors kept her agonizing for a whole afternoon.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
As always, Angelina weaves lightly between the towering buildings.
Forget the complicated calculations and analyses—right now, she is the one who decides who the sky will welcome with open arms.
